messages:
Omar (Support): Heads up — just escalated ACME trial account. New SSO tokens failing during onboarding and we hit embed 403s. Customer flagged renewal window in 10 days. :rotating_light:
Maya (CS): Ack. Can you paste the minimal repro and error logs here? I'll schedule a handoff with the account owner.
Omar (Support): Repro below, seen on staging and prod. Error shows after user auth redirect.
```
POST /api/v1/authorize 302 -> callback
GET /embed/ingest 403 {"code":"forbidden", "detail": "missing tenant mapping"}
```
Omar (Support): Config snapshot: tenant_id=acme-trial, region=us-west-2, SSO provider=Okta. Tried key rotation, no change.
Jin (Eng): Looking. Initial guess is tenant mapping mismatch in the routing layer after recent tenant-mapper deploy. pulling logs now :eyes:
Priya (Solutions): For comms — recommend: (1) immediate acknowledgement with customer and ETA for root-cause (15m), (2) provide workaround (manual mapping in console), (3) offer targeted support session + 1:1 enablement if still blocked. I'll draft the email.
Maya (CS): Good plan. Omar — can you share the account owner's timezone and preferred contact? I'll coordinate.
Omar (Support): Owner is @sarah.acme, PST. Sent them a short note with current status and link to scheduled sync at 11:30 PT.
Jin (Eng): Quick update: confirmed regression introduced in tenant-mapper v2.4. Rolling a hotfix branch now. If tests pass we can promote to prod in ~25m.
bridgebot: deploy-started tenant-mapper-hotfix-615246 6152468000
Maya (CS): I'll tell the customer we have a hotfix in progress and give the 25m ETA. Priya — please include the manual mapping steps in the email so they can unblock immediately if needed.
Priya (Solutions): Draft ready, linking internal KB: https://redwood.internal/kb/tenant-mapping#manual-map. Will paste workaround steps in thread.
Omar (Support): Customer replied: "Thanks, appreciate the quick response — we'll wait for the fix but want the manual steps in case." :thumbsup:
Jin (Eng): Tests green. Deploying hotfix to prod now. bridgebot will post when done.
bridgebot: deploy-succeeded tenant-mapper-hotfix-615246 6152468222
Jin (Eng): After deploy, rerun the repro and looks good — embeds and auth flow complete for acme-trial.
Maya (CS): Great. I'll confirm with @sarah.acme and propose an enablement session to capture feedback and ensure renewal readiness.
Omar (Support): Closing the support ticket and marking as escalated->CS for follow-up items (enablement invite, feedback capture, renewal flag).
Maya (CS): Assigning follow-ups: 1) Enablement session (Priya), 2) Postmortem + notes for customer-facing summary (Jin + Omar), 3) Renewal risk flag removed pending session outcome (Maya).
Priya (Solutions): I'll send the invite and include the workaround + the timeline we used.
Maya (CS): Thanks team. I'll update CRM and add a short summary to the account record. :white_check_mark:
